verdict.rationale: Missive's changelog shows AI triage only as something you build: an external agent connected over MCP can 'triage new conversations against your CRM' and 'summarize your inbox,' with permissions you choose. The built-in assistant runs on your own Anthropic, OpenAI or Gemini key, and auditability comes from the session tab showing what the assistant is doing plus Missive's action log. Missing for 10: native AI auto-labeling or categorization, AI-driven surfacing of what needs attention (the 1000 rules are not shown to be AI-driven), documented ways to steer triage behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
